title: Normalized collection definition (legacy collections domain)
description: Contract for one normalized collection: one stored legacy collections entry. String-encoded id and cashPrice coerce to numbers (rule Q1), embedded-JSON item_ids/prize strings coerce to structures (rule Q2), and item_refs/prize_refs carry the resolved cross-domain item references validated against the normalized items legacy-ID set (rule Q5). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Stored collections string id, preserved verbatim (rule Q4).

kind.description: Classification of the stored collections domain: every collections entry maps to collection.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets collections).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets collections).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

id.description: Stored string id coerced to an integer (rule Q1).

item_ids.description: Required item ids coerced from the embedded-JSON string to an integer array (rule Q2); every id must resolve against the normalized items legacy-ID set (rule Q5).

item_refs.description: Resolved cross-domain references for item_ids: the same ids as decimal legacy_id strings in stored order (rule Q5).

prize.description: Prize map coerced from the embedded-JSON string to an object of item-id keys to positive counts (rule Q2); every key must resolve against the normalized items legacy-ID set (rule Q5).

prize_refs.description: Resolved cross-domain references for the prize keys: the prize item ids as decimal legacy_id strings in sorted order (rule Q5).

cashPrice.description: Stored string-encoded cash price coerced to an integer (rule Q1).
